en: Sepia-toned historic street scene showing Freiberger Straße in the town of Wilsdruff. Two- and three-story buildings line a gently curving cobblestone street. On the right is a long building with signs for a restaurant named "Stadt Dresden". On the left, shopfronts include a sign for artificial flowers. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks and a few horse-drawn carts are visible further down the street. The title "Wilsdruff – Freiberger Straße" appears at the top.
